common.openCopyHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
shell.compactIdle: Press Start, then queue for a match
brawl.detail.idle: Press Start, then queue for Keybound Brawler at the Gold Saucer.
brawl.detail.match: Typing starts as soon as the Keybound Brawler input bar appears.
brawl.detail.focus: The input bar lost focus, so typing is paused to keep phrases out of the chat box.
brawl.title.elsewhere: Paused while another text box is in use.
brawl.detail.elsewhere: Typing picks up again once you leave chat or the other text box.
brawl.detail.wave: Waiting for the next phrases to appear above the enemies.
brawl.detail.holding: An enemy cast just completed, so no keys are pressed until it lands.
brawl.detail.stalled: Inputs may be disabled for a moment. Retrying.
brawl.boardEmpty: Phrases show up here during a match.
brawl.snapshotHint: Writes the brawler's on-screen layout to the Console for a bug report.
settings.languageHelpBrawl: Language for this plugin's interface. Phrases are always typed exactly as the game shows them.
settings.themeHelp: Colours for the whole window. Liquid, Eorzea, Aurora and the Clear themes are see-through glass over the game.
settings.appearanceHelp: The dark or light version of the theme.
settings.dragAnywhereHelp: Move the window by dragging anywhere inside it. When off, only the top bar moves it.
settings.speedHelp: How quickly keys are sent. Each key waits until the input bar shows it before the next one goes out.
settings.speed.relaxedDetail: About 60 words a minute, with uneven gaps like a person typing.
settings.speed.fastDetail: About 160 words a minute, a very quick human pace.
settings.speed.blazingDetail: As fast as the input bar accepts keys, far beyond any person.
settings.inputMethodHelp: How each finished word reaches the game. Type keys presses its letters into the input bar and then Enter, like a player at the keyboard. Submit directly waits as long as typing the word would take at your speed, humanizer pauses included, then hands it straight to the game, so the input bar never needs focus. Both hold still for Letterlock casts. If the game's word data cannot be read, typing takes over for the rest of the session.
settings.inputMethod.typingDetail: Presses each letter into the input bar, then Enter.
settings.inputMethod.directDetail: Waits as long as typing would take, then hands the word to the game.
settings.autoFocusKeyHelp: Brings the input bar back whenever it loses focus during a match, the way a player does: by pressing the first key of the next phrase. It never takes focus from chat or another text box while you are typing in it.
settings.orderHelp: Which enemy's phrase is typed first. Barrier phrases and enemies whose spell can be interrupted always come before this order.
settings.order.smartDetail: The enemy closest to the barrier first, switching to the shortest phrase first once the screen gets crowded.
settings.order.closestDetail: Always the enemy that has walked closest to the barrier first.
settings.order.shortestDetail: Always the shortest phrase on screen first, to thin out the crowd quickly.
settings.crowdedAtHelp: How many phrases on screen count as crowded, the point where Smart starts typing the shortest phrases first.
settings.letterlockTimedHelp: Stops pressing keys from just before a Letterlock cast such as Cursed Gaze completes until its attack lands, so it cannot lock your inputs, and for a moment after any other cast completes.
settings.castsFootnote: Words over the barrier are always typed first so the shield is charged before a Barrier Buster lands, and an enemy whose spell can be interrupted is hit until the spell stops.
settings.snapshotsHelp: Writes the brawler's on-screen layout to the Console a second into the first cast of every spell, and the first time a barrier phrase or a full cast shows up, so a log sent with a bug report shows what the plugin saw.
settings.safetyFootnote: Typing pauses whenever the input bar loses focus, so a phrase is never typed into the chat box.
settings.queueFootnote: Start near the registrar at Keybound Square. After every match the results are closed and the next registration is made for you.
settings.autoQueueHelp: While auto typing is on, closes the results after each match and registers for the next one at the registrar, so matches run back to back.
settings.walkToRegistrarHelp: Walks to the registrar with vnavmesh when you stand more than 3 yalms away. When off, or without vnavmesh, auto queue waits for you to move closer.
settings.stopAfterMatchesHelp: Turns auto typing off once this many matches are done in this session. At 0 it never stops.
settings.stopAtMgcCapHelp: Turns auto typing off when another match could push your MGC past the 10,000 cap, so no coins go to waste.
settings.lifetimeHelp: Every match the plugin has counted across all sessions, and the coins they paid.
queue.status.inQueue: In the queue for the next match.
queue.status.findingRegistrar: Go to the registrar at Keybound Square.
queue.status.waitingForNavmesh: Waiting for vnavmesh to load the area.
queue.status.busy: Waiting for your character to be free.
queue.detail.running: Auto queue joins match after match until you press Stop or a limit is reached.
queue.detail.stopped: Auto typing turned off. Press Start to carry on.
humanizer.enabledHelp: Wait a random moment before each action below, drawn anew each time between the shortest and the longest value. A shortest value above the longest is used as a fixed wait. Off acts at once.
humanizer.reactHelp: Before the first key of a fresh phrase, the moment a player takes to read it.
humanizer.submitHelp: After the last letter, before the phrase is submitted. With the humanizer off, the typing speed's own short pause is used.
humanizer.typosHelp: Now and then a neighbouring key is hit by mistake, then erased with Backspace and fixed. Enter is only ever pressed on a correct phrase.
log.title: Console
log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a run and every step the plugin takes shows up here.
log.noMatches: No lines match the current filters.
log.footer: Every line also goes to the Dalamud log (/xllog) with the {0} prefix. When reporting a bug, press Copy log and paste the result into the issue.
log.copyTooltip: Copies the lines shown below with a header naming the plugin version, Dalamud version and zone, ready to paste into a bug report.
log.levelTooltip: Click to show or hide these lines. Shift-click to show only this level.
log.sourceChipTooltip: Click to stop filtering by source.
log.shortcuts: Ctrl+F search · Ctrl+C copy · Shift-click selects a range · Double-click copies a line
log.copyToEnd: Copy from here to the end
log.hasDetails: Has a stack trace. Select the line to read it.
changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1520.1: Submit directly is now the default input method, and everyone is switched to it once: it needs no input bar focus, so there is no more clicking the bar at the start of a match or a wave. Type keys is still under Settings, Typing
changelog.r1520.2: Type keys pauses while a text box in a plugin window is in use, so phrases are no longer typed into it
changelog.r1520.3: Letterlock: keys now stay still for three and a half seconds after Cursed Gaze or Dynamic Sensory Jammer completes instead of two, since typing started again just before the lockout landed
changelog.r1520.4: Auto queue measures its reach to the registrar between hitboxes, so it registers from the front of the counter instead of running into the desk or waiting a few yalms away
changelog.r1520.5: The Console notes your statuses whenever they change during a match, to find the status the Letterlock lockout puts on you
changelog.r1520.6: Keys also stay still for as long as Cursed Gaze's status is on you, so a gaze that lands late, on a slow connection for example, no longer locks your inputs
changelog.r1520.7: The Language and Theme menus and the Console's search box no longer show a stray internal name such as ##akb_language
changelog.r1510.1: A phrase only a few letters from done is finished before switching to a more urgent one, instead of being deleted and typed again later
changelog.r1510.2: UI snapshots are written one line per window, so they survive being pasted into a bug report
changelog.r1500.1: Auto queue: closes the results, walks to the Keybound registrar (with vnavmesh when installed), registers and accepts the duty, match after match. It can stop after a number of matches or before the MGC cap
changelog.r1500.2: Reads the brawler's own word list: barrier words, casting enemies and Japanese readings now come straight from the game instead of the screen layout, and words of defeated enemies are skipped
changelog.r1500.3: Closest first now uses each enemy's real distance to you
changelog.r1500.4: Letterlock is timed from the enemy's own cast: keys stop just before Cursed Gaze or Dynamic Sensory Jammer completes and resume two seconds after
changelog.r1500.5: New input method under Settings, Typing: Submit directly sends each word to the game after a typing-length wait, with no input bar focus needed
changelog.r1500.6: MGC and MGP earned show in the status card, with lifetime totals under Settings, Typing
changelog.r1440.1: Fixed being expelled for inactivity while the plugin was typing: the duty keeps an idle timer of its own, and it is now reset during the match too
changelog.r1440.2: Dynamic Sensory Jammer is handled like Cursed Gaze: no keys are pressed while it lands
changelog.r1430.3: Bigger text on the Brawl page: the quick settings, their labels and the All settings button now match the size of the rest of the window, and follow Dalamud's font size
changelog.r1430.4: Tooltips and option labels are as large as the rest of the window's text, and the top bar and the Start bar now use the theme's bar style: real glass on the glass themes
changelog.r1430.5: The whole window is now built from Glasswork: Start and Stop, the top bar, the side rail, every Settings control, the Console's buttons and every card, so each theme reaches all of it
changelog.r1430.1: Controller layout: the controller and mouse inactivity timers are reset during a match too, since players on the controller layout were expelled while their words were landing
changelog.r1430.2: The Console notes the game's inactivity timers every 15 seconds during a match, and Copy log no longer passes on characters that broke logs pasted into Discord
changelog.r1420.1: UI snapshots are now on for everyone, so a log sent with a bug report shows what the plugin saw. They can be turned off under Settings, General, Diagnostics
changelog.r1410.2: Fixed only the first barrier phrase being typed: every later one appears over the barrier's gauge and was taken for an enemy's. A phrase that appears where a barrier phrase just was is now typed as one
changelog.r1410.1: With the humanizer on, the reading pause before a new phrase now applies to every word, including the next word of the enemy just hit
changelog.r1410.3: The glass themes no longer light up under the cursor
changelog.r1400.1: A cleaner Brawl page: one status card shows the phrase being typed with a progress ring, the Letterlock countdown and the session's numbers, next to the live board and quick settings, with far less text
changelog.r1400.2: Themes: every Glasswork theme (Neutral, Catppuccin, Nord, Eorzea, the Clear themes and more), dark or light, under Settings, General
changelog.r1400.3: Fixed Cursed Gaze still locking inputs: the hold no longer ends when the cast bar vanishes and now lasts 3.5 seconds after the bar fills
changelog.r1400.4: Barrier words keep their top priority while a charge gauge fades in under them, and an enemy word can no longer turn into a barrier word mid-fight
changelog.r1400.5: The input bar is woken with a real key press while the game window is in front, and focusing it no longer parks the controller hand cursor on the bar
changelog.r1400.6: With Record UI snapshots on, the first cast of every spell and the first barrier words are written to the Console; it also names the last cast when focus is lost right after it
changelog.r1400.7: Japanese client: the input bar is now woken even when the next phrase starts with kana or kanji; it used to stay unfocused and players were expelled for inactivity. A plugin window popped out of the game window hands the keyboard back to the game while phrases are up
changelog.r1320.1: Fixed players still being expelled for inactivity: the match no longer counts as idle while auto typing is on, even while the typer waits for focus, a cast or the next wave
changelog.r1320.2: The input bar is woken the way a player does it, by pressing the first key of the next phrase, so it no longer needs a click at the start of a wave or after a debuff
changelog.r1320.3: Fixed words being typed again after they were already cleared: hidden words are only read while the obscuring noise is on the box
changelog.r1320.4: Holds still for a moment after every enemy cast that completes, not only Cursed Gaze, so Letterlock casts are respected; the console names a cast when keys stop landing right after it
changelog.r1310.1: Stopped typing a word a second time for nothing: enemies get a new word after every hit and the old one lingers for a moment, so it is now skipped briefly
changelog.r1310.2: The next word of the enemy just hit is typed without a reading pause, which makes interrupts faster
changelog.r1310.3: The focus warning only shows when the input bar really stays unfocused while words are up, not after every Enter or between waves
changelog.r1300.1: The input bar is focused again on its own at the start of each wave and after a debuff, going through the same steps as a mouse click
changelog.r1300.2: Every enemy with a cast bar now goes before plain enemies, interruptible ones and the cast closest to finishing first; cast bars and enemy HP bars are read from every part of their window
changelog.r1300.3: While a debuff hides the phrases, the word being typed is finished from memory instead of being deleted and typed again
changelog.r1300.4: Clearing keeps the letters that still match the next phrase and removes the rest in one burst, like holding Backspace
changelog.r1300.5: Optional punctuation (? ! - ') is skipped, as the game's input rules allow
changelog.r1300.6: The Brawl page lists the enemy casts it sees and has quick settings for speed, target priority, humanizer, focus and Letterlock
changelog.r1220.1: Japanese clients: phrases are typed as their hiragana reading, the form the game checks, instead of the kanji or katakana shown on screen
changelog.r1210.1: Fixed being expelled from the match for extended inactivity while the plugin was typing: its keys now count as activity, like a real keyboard
changelog.r1210.2: Fixed letters sometimes going in twice after an enemy vanished or a phrase was rejected
changelog.r1210.3: Phrases a boss hides (Cryptic Communications) are still typed, from what the box last showed
changelog.r1210.4: Clearing the input bar is faster than typing, like holding Backspace, and the typer no longer turns itself off when inputs are disabled for a while
changelog.r1200.1: Fixed the boss's phrase being taken for a barrier phrase, which kept it on top and left the shield uncharged during Barrier Busters
changelog.r1200.2: A phrase typed 3 times in a row with no visible effect now steps aside for a few seconds so the other phrases get typed
changelog.r1200.3: Recognises Letterlock casts such as Cursed Gaze by name and holds still only for those, instead of after every cast
changelog.r1200.4: New Target priority setting: Smart, Closest first or Shortest first, with the crowd size where Smart switches to shortest (Settings, Typing)
changelog.r1200.5: The console names every enemy cast as it starts, marking Letterlock and interruptible ones
changelog.r1100.1: Types the words over the barrier first during a Barrier Buster, charging the shield before the attack lands
changelog.r1100.2: Keeps hitting an enemy whose spell can be interrupted until the spell stops, the cast closest to going off first
changelog.r1100.3: Holds still when a cast bar fills, so a Letterlock attack cannot lock your inputs (Settings, Typing)
changelog.r1100.4: Hits the same enemy again right away instead of moving to another one after every word
changelog.r1100.5: Optional UI snapshots in the Console (Settings, General) to help pin down new mechanics
changelog.r1000.1: First release: types the phrases above the enemies in Keybound Brawler and presses Enter for you
changelog.r1000.2: Clicks back into the input bar on its own whenever it loses focus, and never types into chat or another text box
changelog.r1000.3: Four typing speeds and a humanizer with reaction pauses and the odd typo
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.fact.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.fact.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.fact.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.fact.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.fact.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.fact.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.fact.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.fact.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.fact.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.fact.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.fact.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quote.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quote.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quote.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quote.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quote.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quote.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quote.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quote.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.joke.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.joke.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.joke.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.joke.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.joke.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.joke.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.joke.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.joke.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.joke.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.joke.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.

plugin.chatStarted: Auto typing on. Queue for Keybound Brawler and the plugin takes it from there.
